prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1208; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was stopped at the light when struck from behind by a third-party vehicle. Police report requested. Both drivers reported being shaken but able to drive from the scene.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports neck and lower back pain beginning the day after the collision, described as a strain. Claimant states they have not retained an attorney and prefers to handle the claim directly. Advised claimant of the right to seek medical evaluation and provided a list of in-network providers.

Entry 3: Claimant submitted a copy of an urgent care visit record. Diagnosis noted as lumbar strain with muscle spasm. Treatment included rest, over-the-counter pain relief, and a referral to physical therapy. Claimant reports pain is moderate and intermittent. Medical records requested with signed authorization.

Entry 4: Reviewed photos of both vehicles. Damage to the rear of the claimant's vehicle is consistent with the reported impact. Repair estimate received from an approved shop. Rental vehicle authorized for the repair period. Liability for the collision appears clear based on the police report and driver statements.

Entry 5: Followed up with claimant regarding physical therapy attendance and symptom progress. Claimant reports improvement and has completed three sessions. No attorney involvement to date. Claim remains open pending final medical records, repair completion, and review of the bodily injury evaluation.
